title: The uncle and Chloe
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Chloe at the shack. The uncle, in the chair, looks at her the way he looked at the dog. 'That one's a coast girl.' Chloe says she's from Seattle now. The uncle says the coast doesn't care where you're from now.

panels.composition: The shack. The UNCLE in the lawn chair. CHLOE standing, the Discman, the cardigan. GULLY at the tank. WOOD. BARNABY.

a young woman with smudged eyeliner, level, black and white, no words

balloons.text: Coast don't care where you're from now.

panels.composition: The dock. The four of them and the dog. Chloe sitting on the dock's edge for the first time this summer, her boots over the water. The uncle watching the bay. Right about that too.
